about: Layer 2 - task-outcome A/B. Each task is answered twice from the SAME prompt: once with bctx-COMPRESSED context (ON) and once with FULL raw context (OFF). Deterministic tasks are scored by a code oracle (substring match); the free-form task is scored by a blind LLM judge shown both answers unlabeled. The claim under test is outcome-equivalence: no drop in success rate + no dropped facts. Compression ratios are measured per task by build_bundles.py and recorded in bundles/<id>/meta.json.

tasks.prompt: Using only the context below, what is the exact name of the function that constructs a query parameter for a FastAPI path operation? Answer with just the function name.
tasks.note: entropy mode ~54% smaller; the answer token survives compression.

tasks.prompt: Using only the context below, list the HTTP method decorators that APIRouter provides (e.g. get, post, ...). List every one you can find.
tasks.note: entropy mode ~36% smaller; tests that no method is dropped by compression.

tasks.prompt: Using only the context below (the output of `git branch -a`), which branch is currently checked out? Answer with just the branch name.
tasks.note: Exact class of the historical ClarityLens bug (dropped `* main`). With compression ON the current-branch marker must survive so the agent still identifies the branch.

tasks.prompt: Using only the context below, which class is responsible for recording undo/redo history, and name two of its methods? Answer with the class name followed by two method names.
tasks.note: signatures outline ~93% smaller; a lossy mode where the class + methods still survive for this file.

tasks.prompt: Using only the context below, summarize in 2-3 sentences what this module does and the main capability it provides.
tasks.note: entropy mode ~25% smaller; free-form answer compared ON vs OFF by a blind judge for substantive equivalence.
